headline: This run was meant to start the grapenuts evaluation (a code review for the checker, survival and energy against the baseline, and a phase diagram) with runs on Hatteras. It couldn't: the grapenuts code is neither on this machine (a Linux container) nor in the program's Hatteras work folder, so nothing of grapenuts was read or run. The plan is written down, and the line needs the code copied to sequel-data/grapenuts.
